overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience. I have built and scaled high-availability systems, from modernizing monoliths to distributed ecosystems. Today, I focus on merging traditional engineering with Data Science and AI (Cursor, Claude) to build faster, smarter products.

highlights: Spearhead maintenance and incremental refactoring of core modules in a high-traffic B2B iGaming monolithic platform (PHP, Docker, MySQL), integrating external APIs and introducing Clean Architecture principles and PHPUnit automated tests.
Optimize database performance through advanced MySQL stored procedures and scheduled events while modularizing legacy frontend components for migration readiness.

Reduced code review rework and accelerated delivery cycles by introducing structured AI-assisted engineering workflows (Claude), including custom Claude Skills for static audits and GitLab Merge Request documentation.
Engineered and scaled internal corporate web systems in a regulated banking environment using PHP, Laravel, and JavaScript within distributed Agile/Scrum teams.
Designed and maintained RESTful APIs (Laravel) and custom WordPress solutions integrated into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Git).
Managed and tuned relational database operations via MySQL stored procedures and events.

Architected and built from scratch a proprietary, multi-tenant CMS in Laravel running as microservices on Kubernetes (AWS), replacing WordPress for high-conversion sales pages and editorial workflows.
Designed high-performance search and caching layers using Elasticsearch, Redis, and MongoDB alongside MySQL.
Evolved high-traffic Vue.js / Nuxt.js applications handling massive concurrent campaign spikes, achieving green scores on Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse (Core Web Vitals).
Maintained high-scale editorial web platforms, diagnosing and resolving production incidents across mission-critical publishing systems.

Led backend architecture (Lumen, Node.js, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Socket.io), UX technical flows, and Scrum ceremonies for an on-demand telemedicine platform, alongside hybrid mobile development (Ionic) and unit testing.
Maintained legacy projects and created new backends.
Created smart digital solutions and hybrid mobile apps.
Developed administrative systems, BI reports, and landing pages.
AI & Machine Learning: In-depth study of ML algorithms, focusing on the architecture and implementation of predictive models. Supervised Learning (Classification) and Clustering.
Data Engineering with Python (Pandas, Scikit-Learn), advanced SQL queries (PostgreSQL), and Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) for strategic insights.
Data-Driven Apps (building interactive frontends with Streamlit), Prompt Engineering, AI Model Life Cycle, and LangChain.
